initial_prompt_instruction: templates/simple.json instructions[1], fixed across UIDs; target names from config.py PROPERTY_FULL_NAMES[*][0] in registry order
continuation_prefix_mode: concatenate original token IDs; strip generated final EOS from context only; no reencoding
wait_condition: initial ended with EOS and remaining generated-token budget > 0
parser_selection: last nonempty match in final newly generated text only; no fallback
property_access: terminal final outputs only, after all approved-budget generation in the worker
seed_scope: once per worker startup; proposed reproducibility choice, not claimed legacy canonical seed
